$comment: Library builds the Compat workflow runs inside s&box against every server change (.github/workflows/compat-matrix.yml, scripts/ci/compat-engine.ps1). Published games embed the library they were built with, so a server change that breaks any of these fails the gate. ref is anything tools/sbox-cli-e2e accepts for --library (main, git:<sha>, r<revision>), or latest:N for the newest N r<revision> releases of sbox-cool/sbox-network-storage. Builds that point at the same commit run once. Pin older revisions players still run as git:<sha>; one that stops compiling on a newer engine is reported as an upstream failure (it fails on the latest release too) instead of blaming the change. knownFailures lists check ids a pinned build fails on every server (documented, immutable library defect); when the only failures on both this build and the latest release are those ids the verdict is `known`, which is reported but not counted as upstream.
